summary_en: Minimum acceptance threshold lowered from 402,600 shares (36.24% S/O) to 261,700 shares (23.56% S/O). Tender price ¥601 per share unchanged. Offer period extended from 2026-07-28 to 2026-08-03 (44 business days from 2026-06-02). Board continues to recommend participation; unchanged intent to achieve full subsidiary status.
title_en: Amendment Notice: Update to Board Opinion Supporting and Recommending Participation in Tender Offer for Yamadai Corporation Shares by Nice Corporation
translation_en_brief: On 2026-07-17, Yamadai Corporation (7426) announced an amendment to its board opinion regarding a tender offer by Nice Corporation. Nice Corporation, as offeror, revised the acquisition terms on its board meeting held the same day. The minimum acceptance threshold was reduced from 402,600 shares (representing 36.24% ownership post-acquisition) to 261,700 shares (representing 23.56% ownership post-acquisition). The tender offer price remains ¥601 per share. The offer period was extended from the originally scheduled 2026-07-28 close to 2026-08-03, comprising 44 business days from the initial 2026-06-02 start date. The stated purpose continues to be achievement of full subsidiary status (完全子会社化). In response to these revised conditions, Yamadai's board of directors voted to maintain its prior stance: expression of support and recommendation that shareholders participate in the tender offer. The company confirmed that Nice Corporation simultaneously published its own announcement of the offer-term modifications.
